title: Payer
description: The party funding a payment instrument. The payer MAY differ from the checkout's buyer, for example when a third party pays for someone else's order or a business pays for an individual's order. When omitted, the payer is the buyer.

identification.description: The payer's legal or tax identification (taxpayer document), required by some payment methods and jurisdictions, such as Pix and boleto in Brazil. A platform SHOULD send it only when the selected handler or jurisdiction requires it.
